records.public_safe_text: while on patrol police responded to an accident major. the notes on the key card stated that it was a motor vehicle vs a pedestrian accident. upon arrival p1 was [medical facility]. i was advised by officers on scene who arrived before me, and sgt k. kircher #3281 that p1 injuries were not life threatening. i was made aware that p1 possibly had a broken leg, and that he possibly had internal injuries. ofc j. kavanagh #1087 advised me that u1 driver was in the backseat of his patrol vehicle. u1 driver stated that [roadway] of employment which is in boerne when the accident occurred. u1 driver stated that he saw p1 at the last minute. u1 driver stated p1 had walked into the roadway from the right side. u1 driver stated [roadway] 1604, and that he took the cloverleaf interchange to get onto ih-10 nb. u1 driver then stated that p1 was just walking, and that he saw p1 too late. u1 driver stated that when he hit p1 he hit p1 with his left fender, and that p1 was almost out of the roadway. when i looked at u1 i did not see any damage to u1 front bumper but u1 did have damage to the windshield on the drivers side. u1 driver stated that p1 did hit his windshield when the accident occurred. u1 driver also stated that p1 did try [roadway]. u1 driver stated that as soon as he crashed into p1, he pulled over and parked. u1 driver stated that he was going approximately 25 mph. i observed u1 further down the roadway in the unprotected median. while speaking to u1 driver i did not find any signs of u1 driver being intoxicated. there were two witness on scene which are listed on the key card. the witness spoke spanish. det d. flores #2560 made the scene, and spoke to the witnesses due to me not being a spanish speaker. det d. flores #2560 advised me that the witnesses stated that they were pulled over onto the unprotected median due to having a blown out tire, and that when p1 saw them he was going to help them. the witnesses also stated [roadway] when he got struck by u1. det d. flores #2560 who is a expert in dwi's due to being a former traffic, and dwi officer spoke to u1 driver and advised me that he also found no signs of u1 driver being intoxicated. while on scene i spoke to a passerby who stopped to help. the passerby stated she is a police officer in boerne and that she was going to work. the passerby advised me that w1 was waiving his hands in the air for help so she pulled over. the passerby stated that she thinks that u1 driver was in his vehicle trying to figure out what happened. the passerby stated that she did not see the accident happen but only saw p1 lying on the ground, and stopped to see if he needed cpr. the passerby is listed on the key card. while looking around while on scene i observed a ford pickup truck that was parked off to the right across the concrete barrier. the area is a construction zone. after speaking to u1 driver, and learning about what the witnesses observed p1 was in the dirt in the construction area, jumped over the concrete barrier on the right side of the roadway, and then got struck by u1. it is possible that p1 was a construction worker but it is unknown at this time. i observed blood on the roadway from p1. tid det c. alsip #2335 was contacted and advised of the incident. tid det c. alsip #2335 advised me that tid would not be making the scene. ofc k. yamaguchi #[medical facility]. before the scene was released i contacted ofc k. yamaguchi #0088 and he advised me that after speaking to medical staff they advised him that p1 was critical but stable. i contacted tid again and advised tid det n. ramsey #2198 of the update on p1. tid det n. ramsey #2198 advised me to have ofc k. yamaguchi #[medical facility] with p1. ofc k. yamaguchi #0088 later advised me that after speaking with tid they would not be making the scene. uedi j. vinton #2075 made the scene for processing. ofc n. dingman #[medical facility] and left p1's phone, wallet, [medical facility] with p1. ofc j. kavanagh #1087 advised me while on scene that u1 driver did not have a dl but had an id. u1 driver was given a dwli citation ([identifier]). u1 driver was given a ride off of the roadway by ofc j. kavanagh #1087. u1 vehicle was towed to growdon. bwc/axon fleet available

records.deidentified_narrative: unit 1 driver entered his vehicle in the rear parking lot of south star bank located at [roadway] #3 in brazoria. unit 2 (pedestrian) was sitting inside her vehicle, having just parked her vehicle in the same parking lot, two parking spaces away from unit 1. unit 1 was facing west in the parked position, exited the parking space and turned northbound inside the parking lot, atttempting to exit the parking lot onto the [roadway]. unit 2 exited her vehicle and began to walk westbound toward south star bank. unit 2 cleared the side of her vehicle and was several feet passed her vehicle in the open parking lot, when unit 1 was attempting to exit the parking lot. unit 1 driver stated he never saw unit 2. unit 1's vehicle's front end passed by unit 2. unit 2 collided with unit 1, causing unit 2 to fall to the ground, backward. unit 2's legs fell into the path of unit 1's rear passenger wheel. unit 1's rear passenger wheel struck and ran over unit 2's left lower leg. i observed an open laceration and blood on unit 2's left leg right above the inside of her ankle. unit 2 also complained of pain in her arm, which was believed to have been from falling to the ground after the initial contact with unit 1. i did not observe any damage to unit 1. unit 2 was transported [roadway] [medical facility] in lake jackson for further evaluation.

records.public_safe_text: unit 1 driver entered his vehicle in the rear parking lot of south star bank located at [roadway] #3 in brazoria. unit 2 (pedestrian) was sitting inside her vehicle, having just parked her vehicle in the same parking lot, two parking spaces away from unit 1. unit 1 was facing west in the parked position, exited the parking space and turned northbound inside the parking lot, atttempting to exit the parking lot onto the [roadway]. unit 2 exited her vehicle and began to walk westbound toward south star bank. unit 2 cleared the side of her vehicle and was several feet passed her vehicle in the open parking lot, when unit 1 was attempting to exit the parking lot. unit 1 driver stated he never saw unit 2. unit 1's vehicle's front end passed by unit 2. unit 2 collided with unit 1, causing unit 2 to fall to the ground, backward. unit 2's legs fell into the path of unit 1's rear passenger wheel. unit 1's rear passenger wheel struck and ran over unit 2's left lower leg. i observed an open laceration and blood on unit 2's left leg right above the inside of her ankle. unit 2 also complained of pain in her arm, which was believed to have been from falling to the ground after the initial contact with unit 1. i did not observe any damage to unit 1. unit 2 was transported [roadway] [medical facility] in lake jackson for further evaluation.

records.deidentified_narrative: unit 5 ([identifier]), unit 6 (trailer) and unit 2 ([identifier]) were parked facing sb in the #2 lane on the [roadway] while completing utility work for spectrum and future infrastructure. unit 2, unit 5 and unit 6 all had their yellow emergency lights on along with orange reflective cones in the roadway while the crews were actively working to fix the fiber optic cables in the area. unit 3 (pedestrian) and unit 4 (pedestrian) were standing in the roadway [roadway] #2 leaning into the passenger door jam of unit 2 looking at a work computer that was mounted inside unit 2. unit 1 (gmc) was driving sb on the [roadway] in the #2 lane approaching the working crew. unit 1 which was being operated by an intoxicated driver failed to control their speed when the front of unit 1 struck the rear of unit 2. the force of the collision then caused unit 2 to launch forward throwing unit 3 (pedestrian) into a [roadway] #2. unit 2 also struck unit 4 (pedestrian) violently causing him to fall back sustaining serious internal injuries to his chest, and head. unit 2 then continued on and struck the rear of unit 6 (trailer) which contained three more utility workers inside, forcing them to lose their balance and fall to the ground inside of the cargo area of the trailer. unit 6 which was attached to unit 5 then jolted forward causing the tongue of unit 6 to jam into the hitch/receiver, and rear of unit 5. it should be noted that the unit 2 was initially parked approximately 25 feet behind unit 6 before being struck by unit 1. unit 4 (pedestrian) was rushed to medical city mckinney by allen fd in critical condition. allen pd traffic unit responded to the scene and took 3d scans of the crash scene using a faro scanner which was uploaded and attached to the case. supplement [date]: blood results for marcus garcia were added to the crash report.

across the crosswalk in the [roadway]. pedestrian advised unit 1 [roadway] of the [roadway] and was stopped at the stop sign. pedestrian stated when in front of the vehicle, the driver of unit 1 failed to yield to the right of way of a pedestrian and struck her when attempting to turn [roadway]. pedestrian stated they incurred significant injury to include internal and external bruising, a concussion, lacerations and bruises on her elbows and knees, and severe soreness on the left side of her body that inhibits her movement and ability to work. pedestrian advised the driver was a younger, skinny black female. i conducted an ncic/tcic return of unit 1's lp which showed rms history for the vehicle being associated with the driver of unit 1 who also matched the given description. i called and spoke with the driver of unit 1 who advised she was stopped at the stop sign while traveling south in the [roadway]. the driver of unit 1 stated they observed pedestrian on the east side of the crosswalk that runs east and west across the [roadway]. the driver of unit 1 stated they attempted to turn [roadway] as she believed pedestrian was not going to cross the sidewalk due to her being on her phone. the driver of unit 1 stated they began accelerating and ""tapped"" pedestrian with the front of their vehicle while traveling ""less than 2mph"". the driver of unit 1 stated pedestrian was still on her phone when the collision occurred. the driver of unit 1 stated pedestrian then began walking backwards when she tripped. the driver of unit 1 stated she stopped to check the welfare of pedestrian who refused any assistance, did not request any information, and later ran from the scene. the driver of unit 1 stated she did not observe any injuries whatsoever on pedestrian. occupant 2 stated she later received medical attention on [date] at houston methodist - clear lake. occupant 2 was listed as ""other"" for type due to a technoligical error that prevented
